profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company headquartered in Dublin, trading under the ticker ACN, with CIK 0001467373. On its own website the company describes itself as embracing the power of change to create value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, and says it works across industries and around the world using emerging technologies and human ingenuity.

Much of the site's material is framed around AI. Accenture writes about helping leaders redesign work, accelerate skills and reinvent HR so that people and AI work together, and it says global executives entered 2026 with confidence after two years of rapid AI acceleration, alongside gaps it says stand in the way of scale and value. Other topics it covers include AI tokenomics, AI return on investment and enterprise AI economics, the power demand that AI places on data centers and a power-first strategy for data center developers, and cyber resilience in what it calls an AI driven threat landscape.

The site also states that Accenture is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships scale AI across global operations.
